kbhe01.title: Text Them First
kbhe01.caption:
Brain wanted 20 minutes of being cool. Heart lasted about three seconds.
Are you a wait-20-minutes person or a send-it-now person?

kbhe02.title: Leave the Couch?
kbhe02.caption:
Taurus had snacks, a blanket and zero plans to move. Then the crush said yes to game night.
Tag the friend who always brings the snacks.

kbhe03.title: Three Chats Open
kbhe03.caption:
Group chat, best friend, crush. Gemini tried to answer all three with paragraphs. It did not go well.
Which chat do you answer first?

kbhe04.title: Old Photos at 2 A.M.
kbhe04.caption:
2 a.m., the camera roll and the beach photo. Cancer's Brain wanted it gone, Heart wanted one more look.
They settled on a folder. You can move on without deleting the memories.

kbhe05.title: The Accidental Post
kbhe05.caption:
Totally not posted for anyone. Refreshed eleven times anyway.
Leo's Heart calls it art. Leo's Brain calls it obvious. Who is right?

kbhe06.title: Voice Note, Take 14
kbhe06.caption:
Eighteen takes of a six-second voice note. The one that got sent was the take where Virgo laughed.
Who else re-records until it sounds like a stranger?

kbhe07.title: "Where Do You Wanna Eat?"
kbhe07.caption:
Libra was asked one simple question and the whole head shut down.
The noodle place won. Then came dessert. Be honest, how long does it take you to pick?

kbhe08.title: The Feelings Vault
kbhe08.caption:
Scorpio keeps feelings in a vault. Heart found the key.
"I like you. A normal amount." Very cool, very normal. Have you ever played it this cool?

kbhe09.title: Date Three, Big Trip
kbhe09.caption:
Date three and Sagittarius already had ten cities on the map.
Brain folded it down to one picnic by the lake. What is your ideal date-three plan?

kbhe10.title: Love, 15 Minutes
kbhe10.caption:
Capricorn penciled in love for Tuesday, 7:15 to 7:30, agenda attached.
Heart cleared the whole evening. Tag the friend who needs to hear this.
